title: Filipino-Style Stir Fry with Shellfish
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry dish made with succulent shellfish and a blend of Filipino spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the shellfish and cook until they start to turn pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the light soy sauce and velvety stir-fry sauce, and stir to combine.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the shellfish are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles.
